submodules.name: bmc_codec
submodules.role: Physical layer: Biphase Mark Coding (BMC) encode/decode on the CC wire at 300 kbaud; recovers clock from the guaranteed BMC transitions.
submodules.evidence: §3: USB-PD uses Biphase Mark Coding (BMC) on the CC wire at a nominal 300 kbaud.

submodules.name: protocol_layer
submodules.role: Frames/deframes Preamble + SOP* ordered set + 16-bit Message Header + 0..7 data objects + CRC-32 + EOP; checks CRC-32 and emits GoodCRC.
submodules.evidence: §4 Packet Framing; §6 Message Header (16 bits); §10: every received message is acknowledged with GoodCRC.

submodules.name: policy_engine
submodules.role: Drives the Explicit Contract negotiation FSM (Source_Capabilities -> Request -> Accept -> PS_RDY) and the PR_Swap/DR_Swap/VCONN_Swap and Soft/Hard/Cable Reset flows.
submodules.evidence: §10 Contract Negotiation; §5 Role Swaps; §11 Reset Mechanisms.

fsm_states.name: AdvertiseCaps
fsm_states.description: Source advertises its PDO list via Source_Capabilities.
fsm_states.evidence: §10.1: Source sends Source_Capabilities (its PDO list) on SOP.

fsm_states.name: EvaluateRequest
fsm_states.description: Source evaluates the Sink's RDO and replies Accept / Reject / Wait.
fsm_states.evidence: §10.2/§10.3: Sink replies with Request carrying an RDO; Source replies Accept (or Reject / Wait).

fsm_states.name: ExplicitContract
fsm_states.description: Contract established after PS_RDY; ready for role swaps.
fsm_states.evidence: §10.4/§10.5: Source transitions VBUS, sends PS_RDY; the Explicit Contract is now in place.

module_role: USB4 router-based tunneling fabric over USB-C. Defines the transport, configuration, and tunneled-protocol layers between host routers, hub routers, and device routers; built on the Thunderbolt 3 protocol donated by Intel.
topology_description: Spanning tree of routers rooted at the host router; hub routers cascade the fabric; device routers are leaves. Each inter-router link is a USB-C dual-lane bidirectional connection.

integration_overview.physical: USB Type-C connector; PD on the connected CC wire; VCONN on the other CC pin
integration_overview.distinct_from: USB 2.0 D+/D- data and USB4 tunneling are carried separately; PD only negotiates power/role over CC
integration_overview.init_sequence: On attach: Source advertises Source_Capabilities; Sink sends Request (RDO); Source Accepts, transitions VBUS, sends PS_RDY to establish the Explicit Contract.

interface_categories: Host router (contains the Connection Manager + host interface adapter)
Hub router (cascades the fabric; multiple downstream lane adapters)
Device router (leaf; USB3 / DP / PCIe adapters)
Protocol adapter (USB3 / DP-IN / DP-OUT / PCIe tunneling endpoint)
interconnect_topologies_supported: Spanning tree of routers rooted at a host router (mandatory).
Daisy-chain of routers via hub routers.
Host-to-host link between two host routers.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: Lanes electrically idle when link is down; LFPS keep-alive when up but idle.
soc_dependent_items: USB4 router IP (transport + configuration + adapter layers).
High-speed PHY (Gen 2 / Gen 3 SerDes; USB4 v2 PAM-3).
USB-C PHY + USB Power Delivery policy engine on CC pins.
Tunneled-protocol controllers (USB3 host, DisplayPort source/sink, PCIe root/endpoint).

low_power_modes.USB4_sleep: Link low-power state; resumes via SBU/LFPS.
low_power_modes.Selective_tunnel_disable: Individual tunnels can be torn down to save power.
low_power_modes.USB_PD_low_power: Negotiated lower power contract on CC pins.

tunneled_protocol_examples: DisplayPort tunnel (external monitors, DP Alt Mode)
device_classes_examples: Standalone PHY chip (e.g. 100BASE-TX or 1000BASE-T transceiver behind MII / GMII / RGMII).
Multi-port Switch ASIC — N MACs + N PHYs + a per-port FIFO + a forwarding engine; each external port is one Ethernet link.
Network Interface Controller (NIC) — MAC + PHY + DMA engine + host bus interface (PCIe).
Industrial-Ethernet PHY (TPS-1 / PROFINET / EtherCAT) — same MAC + RS + MII + MDIO; added IRT scheduling at MAC client.
Automotive Ethernet PHY (100BASE-T1 / 1000BASE-T1) — single-pair full-duplex; same MAC + MII; PMD differs.
